system.description:
• Effect: Cast a spell even with no slots of that level remaining by paying with Spellburn: burn Constitution points equal to twice the spell's level, a flat cost that doesn't double and doesn't count towards the day's doubling.
  • The magic tears through you: you also take 1d6 damage per spell level, which cannot be reduced by any means.
  • You may add a Metamagic option, paid for as usual.
  • This is the Sorcerer's answer to having fewer slots than a Wizard: you're never truly out of options, just paying more for the privilege.
  • 18th level: once per day, you Overchannel without taking its damage.

activities.name: Overchannel
activities.text: Cast a spell with no slots of its level left by paying with Spellburn: burn Constitution points equal to twice the spell's level (a flat cost that doesn't double). You also take 1d6 unavoidable damage per spell level.

activities.name: Overchannel (no damage)
activities.text: Once per day from 18th: Overchannel without taking its damage (you still burn the Constitution points).
